capabilities: Add a note header with cover image, editable title and property rows
Read and write frontmatter properties from the header, including type changes
Insert basic Markdown blocks through slash commands
Format selected text with a popup toolbar
disambiguation: Not a Notion integration or sync tool; it only reproduces Notion-style editing UI inside Obsidian.
extras: Manual install: copy main.js, manifest.json and styles.css into .obsidian/plugins/notioneer/. Since 2.0.0 the note header is a port of make.md's components, DOM and styling running on Obsidian's API; make.md is MIT (Copyright (c) 2022 JP Cen, licence in LICENSE-makemd) while Notioneer is GPLv3. All inserted blocks are plain Markdown; spaces, custom file formats and make.md-specific block syntax are explicitly excluded. Architecture notes in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.
intentEvidence: inspired by make.md but deliberately narrower
problem: Obsidian has no built-in note header for covers, titles and properties, and inserting blocks or applying inline formatting requires manual markup or nested menus.

relations.evidence: inspired by make.md but deliberately narrower

summary: Editing plugin that adds a Notion-style note header with cover, title and property rows, plus Markdown slash commands and a selection formatting toolbar.
